articles.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
articles.summary: Small AI models may be only months away from being able to self-replicate across cheap IoT devices like Android TV boxes, with no datacenter needed.

articles.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
articles.summary: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.
